description: This Saturday is my Alive Day. On September 19, 2010, I stepped on an IED while serving in Afghanistan. I lost both legs and a finger. I nearly lost my life. The road back was long, but I came home with something even stronger than before: a responsibility to make every day count.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Mast for Congress Hon
title: What Service Before Self Means To Me - Mast for Congress | Mast for Congress
